description: eSWua, the electronic Space Weather upper atmosphere service of INGV, gives real-time ionospheric information from INGV instruments. Its menu offers HF systems (real-time vertical soundings, HF maps, a vertical soundings explorer and an ionospheric parameters explorer), GNSS scintillation (real-time scintillation, a parameters explorer, an overview and a scintillation climatology) and GNSS total electron content (real-time TEC, a TEC maps explorer and a TEC data explorer), each with data collection information, plus a data comparison tool, a download tool, a web service, and an overview and real-time status of the network. The content is released under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence and access is free; users can register to an eSWua Google Group. Caveats: the explorers run inside frames rendered by scripts, so the cloud session could read only the menu, and the station network and period covered are given on the collection pages. Coverage is centred on Italy and INGV stations, with instruments listed in the network overview. It supports hazard exposure analysis of space weather effects on GNSS positioning and HF radio used by infrastructure operators; related records are the DLR ionosphere monitoring service and the ESA Space Weather Service Network.
